evidence.note: writer: fsm init resolves the branch from symbolic-ref (full refname via scope.BranchName), lists refs/heads, folds case only when refs/heads/<spelling> resolves (scope.Canonical), requires --for-branch on a detached HEAD naming an exact local branch, and passes Branch into machine.InitOptions
machine.Init writes o.Branch into run.InitData.Branch (json "branch", omitempty) beside Head in the init event
fork copies the parent's InitData (cd := pd), so a child keeps the parent's Branch and records its own fork-time Head; both legs of Classify still apply to the child

reader: abandonedRun decodes branch and head from the init event only (the same json tags event.go writes), and scanAbandonedRuns classifies with scope.Load(root) / Classify(branch, head); legacy and store sources deduped by id with in-scope winning

Load uses the same full-refname rule and the same rev-parse --verify guard before Canonical as init, so the recorded spelling and the compared spelling agree; rebasing() joins --git-path output with root, correct from a subdirectory root (verified: git prints ../.git/... relative to cwd)

unscoped/--target and --scope branch reports both take r.Abandoned from ScanAbandonedRuns and render the branch in the blocker target; counts for other-branch/orphaned always present, Elsewhere list only with --all; CommitBlockers still excludes fsm-run blockers
plain status renders the same scan via abandonedLines; --all stripped before argument parsing so it never changes the exit code, matching commands/status.md and docs/fsm/driving-a-workflow.md

Docs vs code: ARCHITECTURE.md branch-scope section, driving-a-workflow.md, skills/fsm/SKILL.md, commands/status.md and the agent-prompt golden all describe the implemented rule (name leg with former names, range leg less remote defaults, fail closed, legacy reachability, --for-branch semantics). tests/go/test-bare-layout.sh updated from the removed bare-main orphan warning to status --all listing under branch gone; repo.MainWorktreeIsBare removal leaves no caller (git grep).
go test ./internal/scope ./internal/status ./internal/fsm/cli ./internal/fsm/machine ./internal/fsm/run ./internal/repo ./internal/githooktest ./cmd/metareview all pass at head ce80bb4.

findings.note: Fork seam (already on the known list: no test for fork keeping Branch): a child forked from a checkout on another branch keeps the parent's recorded Branch but records that checkout's head, so it blocks the parent's branch by name and the forking branch by range. Over-blocks rather than clears, so the fail-closed direction holds; a regression test that a fork preserves Branch would pin it.

Writer/reader asymmetry on the case-fold guard (also raised in shard-3): init treats any rev-parse --verify failure as 'do not fold' and records HEAD's spelling, while scope.Load leaves the scope unknown (everything in scope) on a non-1 exit. Only reachable on a case-insensitive filesystem with a git failure at init; the resulting mis-spelled branch still matches via the range leg on its own branch, and an unmatched name reads as orphaned, so impact is limited to a stacked/detached corner. Could fail init with ERR_GIT on code != 1 for symmetry.
Cosmetic doc defect (also shard-0): the Known trade-offs list in ARCHITECTURE.md has a sentence starting lowercase ('local `main` or `master`. a squash-merged ...'). No behavioural effect.
